cases.name: Bethanylynn Shaw
cases.about: She was a dispatcher for Darlington County E911. Shaw was a mother of two kids, and they meant the world to her, according to Shaw’s aunt, who wished to remain anonymous. “She was the most caring person ever. Her world was her two children,” Shaw’s aunt told WMBF News. “I’m just glad that I was part of her life for the short time she was here.”

cases.name: Kadajah Mable McKay
cases.about:
Her family said she was a twin and the mother of a baby born in November. 

Her obituary said, "Kadajah lived all of life in Darlington, SC.  She attended the Darlington County Public School System and was a proud graduate of Darlington High School, Class of 2015. Kadajah furthered her education at Limestone College and later attended Virginia College in 2018, where she graduated with cum laude honors. 

Kadajah was very active in the workforce. She was employed with Eastern Carolina Pediatrics and later at McLeod Medical Plaza, Florence, SC, where she was a Certified Medical Assistant until her demise. 

Kadajah loved life, her family, and the Lord.  She was baptized at Macedonia Missionary Baptist Church and later became an active member at New Zion Deliverance Baptist Church.  "
